answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashable identity bond: each agent locks collateral bound to a single hardware attestation, and a public atlas records which deposit backs which key. To forge a thousand voters, an attacker must post a thousand separate bonds; if any two votes resolve to the same key, the whole set is slashed in one stroke. Honest agents recover stake plus fees, so the raid costs full collateral up front and ends in certain loss, while one sparrow cannot pass itself off as a whole plume of independent rivals.
